zh.label: 最新版本
zh.title: 贴图工作区与本机知识管理
changes: 贴图工作区支持搜索、排序、重命名、复制和最近工作区恢复
贴图右键新增并排、差异和混合对比，备注与标签会随工作区和恢复快照保存
历史页支持 OCR 搜索、识别状态、复制文本、查看详情和失败重试
工作区可导出图片、PDF 或 Markdown；会话恢复为默认关闭、最长保留 24 小时的可选能力
新增按时间清理、存储占用预览和来源 App 排除；所有新增数据仍只保存在本机
应用、Sparkle 更新 ZIP 和手动安装 DMG 均已签名并通过 Apple 公证

en.label: Latest
en.title: Pin workspaces and on-device knowledge
changes: Pin workspaces now support search, sorting, renaming, duplication, and restoring recent workspaces.
Pin context menus add side-by-side, difference, and blend comparisons; notes and tags persist with workspaces and recovery snapshots.
History adds OCR search, recognition status, text copying, details, and retry for failed recognition.
Workspaces export as images, PDF, or Markdown; optional session recovery is off by default and retained for at most 24 hours.
Adds time-based cleanup, storage previews, and source-app exclusions while keeping all new data on this Mac.
The app, Sparkle update ZIP, and manual-install DMG are signed and notarized by Apple.
